verdict.rationale: LocalAI is an inference runtime and platform, not purely an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Every MCP item in the pack describes client-side use: connecting models and agents to external MCP servers via `metadata.mcp_servers` or per-agent attachments. Nothing shows LocalAI itself running as an MCP server that other agents can connect to, and client-side MCP support cannot be credited here.
